budget.rule: max(established 6000, ceil(5 x |full| / batch 4) rounded up to 100)

env.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

bootstrap.unit: contiguous blocks of 20 development anchors (stride-3 stream frames, i.e. 60 stream frames per block, > the 20-frame target horizon)
bootstrap.paired: identical block draws for small and full within a seed
bootstrap.scope: evaluation uncertainty only; training variance is shown by the two seeds
